rules: Every structural record must cite basis/evidence or use NOT_APPLICABLE/UNSUPPORTED.
Analyzer candidates are never authoritative findings.
The campaign artifact must contain no __FILL_REQUIRED__ sentinel before Phase 1 seals.
The artifact is immutable once sealed; replacement requires a new version/revision and invalidation record.
Later phases reuse this artifact for matching source/build identity rather than recreating the same structural inventories.
Phase 1 owns structural security-surface and protocol-topology collection; later phases own semantic analysis and discrepancy records, not reconstruction.
Mutable routes identify navigation targets only. The campaign bundle index supplies accepted revision, immutable commit, digest, status, and invalidation state.
